products.title: Teacher Weekly Planner with Grades and Attendance
products.summary: Printable A4 teacher planner, 52 pages: class roster, a gradebook page per term, monthly attendance (Sep-Jun) and 36 Monday-Friday lesson plans by period.
products.description:
A printable A4 PDF planner for teachers, 52 pages for a whole school year:
- Cover page (teacher, school, class, school year)
- Class roster for up to 30 students with parent / guardian contact and notes
- Gradebook: one page per term (4 terms), 12 columns for tests and assignments plus a final grade column
- Attendance: one page per month from September to June, days 1-31, with present / absent totals
- 36 weekly lesson plans: Monday to Friday by period (6 periods), plus To do and Notes

Print the pages you need, as many times as you need, for your own classes. This is a static printable for pen and paper (no automatic calculations). Instant digital download.

Made by Digital Business Studio with the help of AI tools; every product is approved by the shop owner before release.
